title: Grilled Australian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine dish made with grilled Australian chicken, perfect for a family dinner.

ingredients.name: Tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice mix and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Brush the spice mix mixture evenly onto both sides of the chicken breast.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is grilling, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Serve the sliced chicken on top of the onion and garlic mixture, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
